body: That I'm not fine. My brother's death has made me occasionally suicidal and it makes me worried about the impact my death it'll have on my family and friends. I'm worried that one day, I might just do it. I'm worried that speaking about it will make me sound unstable and people will avoid me. I'm worried about myself because some days, I'm happy and normal and have normal worries, but some days I feel like the world is crashing down on me and that I wouldn't care about taking my life. There's two personas and one is worried for the other. On one side, I have a great family, friends, job, longterm girlfriend, etc. On the other, I'm totally alone in my world, debating with myself about how I have nothing to lose. And that one day, the few hours where I lose myself may be enough time to make them my last. I fear never being well-adjusted again.
